background.reason: Figma's neutral sample is the primitive color/neutral/50, which component code may not name. Without the caller's colour, the avatar is surface/feedback/neutral/subtle, neutral/50 in Light, and re-themed in Dark.

gap.reason: Same value, governed token: a gap Figma leaves unbound at 0 is the none of its family, and SOLAR picks the family by direction, as its own bound gaps do: a horizontal auto layout's gap is an inset, a vertical one's a stack (the Foundations agent reference and the Spatial chapter). Decided once here, as the paddings are.

docs.description: User/entity avatar showing initials, photo, or company logo. 114 variants: size (xs, sm, md, lg) × type (text, photo, logo) × color (9 seeds) × shade (Light, Medium, Dark, Image, Logo). Color provides 9 distinct seeds for initial-based avatars; seed from a stable hash of user ID — never random. Dark shade inverts colors for dark surfaces and inverse cards; Image and Logo are the content modes for photo and logo. Use in activity feeds, comment threads, user lists, presence indicators, and permissioned resources. See also: Badge / Status for small inline status dots.

root.background.reason: The caller's colour, any colour (design team, 2026-09-24): the prop is the avatar's fill. Without one, it is the recipe's, surface/feedback/neutral/subtle.

initials.color.reason: The initials take the caller's colour's hue at a lightness that reads at WCAG AA (owner decision, 2026-09-24), computed where the colour is given (internal/ink.ts, solar_ink.dart): not Figma's sample's ink, so it is not compared. Without a colour they are the recipe's, color.text.primary.

rules.reason: MUI's Avatar on the web, which draws initials, or a picture with its fallback, restyled by the recipe; bespoke in Flutter, whose CircleAvatar cannot draw the logo's rounded square. Its colour is the caller's, any colour (design team, 2026-09-24).
A logo has no border; initials and a photo have the subtle one.
Figma lays a photo's and a logo's frame out across and the initials' down; each centres its one child, so both are drawn as Figma has them.
A logo sits in a rounded square (radius.container), "centred, not cropped"; initials and a photo in a circle (radius.pill).
Figma's neutral sample's ink is the primitive color/neutral/700. Without the caller's colour, the initials are color.text.primary, which reads on the neutral fill in Light and Dark.

Light, Medium and Dark are samples of the caller's colour too, drawn light or dark; Image and Logo are the photo's and the logo's own, one for each type, so they stay with it.
